clips.send: A worried patient sends this to a parent before their next checkup - anxiety, wanting a second look at the number.
clips.caption:
On The Kevin Trudeau Show, Kevin Trudeau points out something most people never question: a lot of blood pressure tests are done with the arm in the wrong position, and that gives a false high reading.

So before anyone panics over a number, his advice is simple: get a home blood pressure kit and check it yourself, more than once, at a few different times of day.

One bad arm position, one false reading, and suddenly you're being told you have a problem you may not have.

Has a doctor's number ever scared you before a second check proved it wrong?

clips.send: A mom sends this to her vegan friend who thinks she eats clean - a little anger, a wake-up call.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau, on The Kevin Trudeau Show, cites an article saying 60% of the average American diet is ultra-processed food - and says even people who think they eat healthy rarely realize how much of their own food fits that description.

His point lands hardest on one group: vegans. Being vegan doesn't mean eating mostly fruit and vegetables, he says - a lot of vegan food, like a frozen vegan pizza, is still heavily processed.

He lists it as one of the biggest hidden causes behind rising blood pressure numbers.

When's the last time you checked how much of your own plate was actually whole food?

#kevintrudeau #ultraprocessedfood #bloodpressure #healthtips #foodlabels #wbdaily

clips.send: A friend sends this to someone who just complained about their blood pressure - practical, a cheap thing to try tonight.
clips.caption:
On The Kevin Trudeau Show, Kevin Trudeau says a heart surgeon he knows traced one of the biggest problems behind high blood pressure back to a simple magnesium deficiency.

His own at-home fix: a couple of cups of Epsom salt, which is really just magnesium, in a warm bath at night. He says it relaxes the muscles, helps the body absorb magnesium through the skin, and helps with sleep too.

He's quick to add he doesn't sell it and makes no money from it - he just uses it himself.

Would you try a bath before reaching for another supplement?

#kevintrudeau #magnesium #bloodpressure #naturalhealth #sleep #wbdaily

clips.send: A parent sends this to a teenager who lives on chips - a little anger at what's really in the bag.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau, on The Kevin Trudeau Show, walks through a short list of everyday ingredients he ties to high blood pressure: genetically modified corn, unfermented high-gluten wheat, and excitotoxins like monosodium glutamate.

His example is blunt: eat a bag of Doritos with MSG in it, he says, and your blood pressure goes up.

If you look at the label, monosodium glutamate is right there in the ingredient list - not hidden, just not read.

When's the last time you actually turned the bag over?

clips.send: A friend sends this to someone who always says they can't sleep - a small, immediate fix to actually try.
clips.caption:
On The Kevin Trudeau Show, Kevin Trudeau says almost nobody's bedroom is actually dark - a smoke detector light, a charger, a crack under the door, it all adds up.

His fix: a thick black silk sleep mask, which he says boosts melatonin and gets people into deeper, more soundly sleep almost immediately.

He also uses a magnetic mattress pad under the sheets, which he says helps circulation while he sleeps.

How many small lights are actually on in your room right now?
